children: Freeport said its 48.76%‑owned PT Freeport Indonesia extended a $1.75 billion revolving credit facility maturity to September 2031.
PTFI amended and restated its $1.75B senior unsecured revolver, moving maturity from Nov 2028 to Sept 2031.
As of Sept 1, 2026, PTFI had $250M drawn under the facility, which remains available for general corporate purposes.
Freeport holds a 48.76% ownership stake in PTFI, making the facility extension material to its subsidiary financing profile.
